# Step 8: Feed the red leads from output transformers to filter capacitor lug #1

> *Feed the red lead from the left output transformer through both cable clamps and the red lead from the right output transformer through the right clamp. Connect both red leads to filter capacitor lug #1 (The lead from the right output transformer can be trimmed to the required length).*

!!! info "Explainer pending"

*Topics to cover when written:*

- What the [A-470 output transformer](../../components/a-470-output-transformer.md) red leads are (primary center taps — the B+ feed into the push-pull primary).
- Why they go to [filter cap](../../components/filter-capacitors.md) lug #1: this is the B+ node that supplies the output transformers' primary center taps.
- Cable clamps: mechanical strain relief and routing — heavy gauge wire under tension would eventually crack solder joints.
- The "quad" filter cap: four separate caps in one can, with separate lugs for each.
- Why both output transformer primaries land at the same B+ node (they share the supply but the two channels are signal-isolated by being driven by independent phase splitters).
